prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Noor Halden for the job below.

About the freelancer: 6 years experience; skills: Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, machine learning

<job>
Title: Write a Data Science practical project for my students using Python/Pandas
# What is DataWars # DataWars is a Data Science education platform that focuses on explaining concepts throughout interactive projects. # Project definition # Your job will be to create a project for our platform on the topic: Filtering and Sorting Pandas DataFrames. You’ll be using a Dataset of FIFA 22 Players (see attached). You’ll have to create different interactive activities for our students that validate that they know the concepts of filtering and conditional selection with Pandas. Your project should be structured in the following sections: 1) A quick overview of the dataset, including a few visualizations of the columns to understand the data. 2) Basic selection using simple comparison operators (greater than, smaller than, equals, etc). 3) Selection combining boolean operators AND (&), OR (|), NOT (~). `df.loc[(df["COLUMN 1"] == 150) & (df["COLUMN 2"] == "Red)]` 4) Selection of values that are duplicate and contain null values. We want you to be creative with the activities that you include, in order to make it engaging for our students. Your project should include AT LEAST 15 activities/questions (of which, at least 10 should be Jupyter/interactive activities). All your activities should have thoughtful solutions explaining the process to solve them, as well as alternatives if possible. # Important Considerations # We are very strict with the format of our projects, so BEFORE YOU ACCEPT this offer, we ask you to do the following two things: ## a) Complete the proj
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
(none)

Style:
- Open by restating the client's specific problem in one sentence.
- Do not mention any specific past project or client.
- Keep it under 150 words.
- End with one specific question about the job.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
You need a practical Data Science project for students on filtering and sorting Pandas DataFrames using the FIFA 22 Players dataset, with interactive activities, visualizations, and clear solutions.  

I’m Noor Halden, a machine learning freelancer with 6 years of experience in Python, pandas, and NLP/ML workflows, and I can help design this as a clear, engaging learning project. I can structure the lesson around basic comparisons, boolean filtering with AND/OR/NOT, and handling duplicates and nulls, while keeping the exercises interactive and student-friendly. I also pay close attention to clean explanations and step-by-step solutions, including alternative approaches where useful.  

Would you like me to first draft the 15+ activity outline before writing the full project?
